briefing.headline: OpenAI GPT-5 launch intensifies US-China frontier model race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has accelerated with multiple frontier releases and record funding. Geopolitical tensions are rising as compute export controls tighten between the US and China. Prompt injection and multi-agent security remain critical unsolved issues.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed GPT-5 with 4.8T parameters. Anthropic and Google DeepMind countered with Claude 4 and Gemini 3.0 respectively while xAI and DeepSeek pushed new open-weight contenders into production.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic systems but enforcement lags.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announced $40B combined data center expansions in Texas and Arizona. TSMC 2nm yields improved while NVIDIA Blackwell supply constraints persist into Q4.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like dynamic dialect negotiation become mandatory infrastructure before the first AGI-level deployment?
